questions.question: When x is added to each of 7, 13, 19 and 29 the numbers so obtatined in this order are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between (3x - 8) and (x + 5)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

x is added to each of 7, 13, 19 and 29

**Formula used:**

If a, b, c, and d are in proportion, then a/b = c/d

Also, b is the mean proportion of a and b then b = √ab

**Calculation:**

(x + 7)/(x + 13) = (x + 19)/(x + 29)

⇒ (x + 7) (x + 29) = (x + 13) (x + 19)

⇒ x2 + 7x + 29x + 203 = x² + 13x + 19x + 247

⇒ 7x + 29x - 13x - 19x = 247 - 203

⇒ 4x = 44

⇒ x = 44/4 = 11

The mean proportion = √[(3x - 8) (x + 5)]

= √[(3 × 11 - 8) (11 + 5)]

= √(25 × 16)

= 20

**∴ The mean proportional between (3x - 8) and (x + 5) is 20**

questions.question: The area of triangular field with the side 60 m, 175 m and 185 m is equal to that of rectangular park whose sides are in the ratio of 21 : 10. The perimeter (in m) of the park is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sides of the triangular field are 60 m, 175 m, and 185 m

The area of the triangular field = The area of the rectangular park

In rectangular park, length : width = 21 : 10

**Formula used:**

The area of a triangle with sides a, b, and c = √[s (s - a) (s - b) (s - c)]

Where, semi-perimeter (s) = (a + b + c)/2

The area of a rectangle = Length × Width

The perimeter of a rectangle = 2 (Length + Width)

**Calculation:**

The semi-perimeter = (60 + 175 + 185)/2 = 420/2 = 210 m

The area of the triangular field = √[210 (210 - 60) (210 - 175) (210 - 185)]

= √(210 × 150 × 35 × 25)

= 5250 

Let, length of the rectangular park = 21x

Width of the rectangular park = 10x

So, 21x × 10x = 5250

⇒ 210x² = 5250

⇒ x2 = 5250/210

⇒ x2 = 25

⇒ x = √25 = 5

So, length = 21 × 5 = 105 m

Width = 10 × 5 = 50 m

Then, the perimeter of the rectangular park = 2 (105 + 50) = 2 × 155 = 310 m

**∴ The perimeter (in m) of the park is 310 m**

questions.question: A can do 40% of a work in 24 days, and B can do **33(1)/(3)**% of the same work in 15 days. They work together for 15 days, C alone completes the remaining work in 10 days. A and C together can complete 35% of the same work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do 40% of a work in 24 days

B can do 33(1)/(3)% of the same work in 15 days

**Concept used:**

Work done = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f59931ae21f7da286dc902968332ae89703c8c804e5591736eba1d1a86b8d2fb.png] **

A can do 100% work = (24/40) × 100 = 60 days

B can do 100% work = (15/33(1)/(3)) × 100 = 45 days

Total work = 180 (LCM of 60 and 45)

Total work done by A and B in 1 day = 3 + 4 = 7 units

A and B complete works in 15 days = 7 × 15 = 105 units

Remaining work = 180 - 105 = 75 units

C can do work in 1 day = 75/10 = 7.5 units

35% of total work = 180 × (35/100) = 63 units

Time taken by A and C to complete 63 unit work = 63/(3 + 7.5) = 63/10.5 = 6 days

**∴ A and C together can complete 35% of the same work in 6 days**

questions.question: X can do a certain work in 40 hours. Y is 25% more efficient then X, and Z is 28% more efficient then Y. Working together, X, Y and Z will complete the same work in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X can do a certain work in 40 hours

Y is 25% more efficient than X

Z is 28% more efficient than Y

**Concept used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

The efficiency of Y = 125% of X = 125X/100

The efficiency of Z = 128% of Y = (125X/100) × (128/100)

X : Y : Z = X : (125X/100) : (125X/100) × (128/100)

= X : 5X/4 : 8X/5

= 20 : 25 : 32

Total work = 20 × 40 = 800 units [∵ X complete in 40 hours]

So, Time required for X, Y, and Z together = 800/(20 + 25 + 32) = 800/77 hours

**∴ X, Y and Z will complete the same work in 800/77 hours**

questions.question: The height of A is 20% more than that of B, and the height of B is 20% less than that of C. The height of C is 30% more than that of D. If the difference between the heights of C and A is 6.8 cm, then what is the height (in cm) of B?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, D's height = 100 units

∴ C's height = 100 + 30% = 130 units

∴ B's height = 130 - 20% = 104 units

∴ A's height = 104 + 20% = 124.8 units

Here, C's height - A's height → (130 - 124.8) units = 5.2 → 6.8 units = 6.8

∴ 104 units = (6.8/5.2) × 104 = 136

∴ The height (in cm) of B is 136 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The height of A is 20% more than that of B

The height of B is 20% less than that of C

The height of C is 30% more than that of D

**Calculation:**

Let, the height of D = x

The height of C = 130x/100 = 13x/10

The height of B = (13x/10) × 80/100 = (13x/10) × 4/5 = 26x/25

The height of A = (26x/25) × (120/100) = 156x/125

So, (13x/10) - (156x/125) = 6.8

⇒ 13x/250 = 68/10

⇒ 13x/25 = 68

⇒ x = (25 × 68)/13

∴ B's height = (26/25) × [(25 × 68)/13] = 136 cm

**∴ The height (in cm) of B is 136 cm**

questions.question: The average of the 3-digit numbers 372, 2x5 and x37 is 498. What is the average of (2x + 7) and (5x - 2)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of the 3-digit numbers 372, 2x5, and x37 = 498

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of the terms/Number of the terms

**Calculation:**

Second number = 2x5 = 200 + 10x + 5 = 10x + 205

Third number = x37 = 100x + 37

⇒ (372 + 10x + 205 + 100x + 37)/3 = 498

⇒ 110x + 614 = 498 × 3

⇒ 110x = 1494 - 614

⇒ 110x = 880

⇒ x = 880/110 = 8

Then, the average of (2x + 7) and (5x - 2) = [(2 × 8 + 7) + (5 × 8 - 2)]/2

= (23 + 38)/2

= 61/2 = 30.5

**∴ The average of (2x + 7) and (5x - 2) is 30.5**

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 600 pens. He sold 480 of them for the price he paid 600 pens, 100 pens at 10% higher rate than that at which he sold 480 pens, and the rest at the cost price. His profit percentage in the transaction is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A shopkeeper sold 480 pens at the cost price of 600 pens.

He sold 100 pens at a 10% higher rate than that at which he sold 480 pens.

**Formula used:**

Profit% = (S.P. - C.P.)/C.P. × 100

Where, S.P. = Selling price; and C.P. = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let, the price of one pen = Rs. 1

The cost of 600 pens = Rs. 600

Also, the selling price of 480 pens = Rs. 600

∴ The selling price of each pen = 600/480 = Rs. 1.25

Also, 1.25 × (110/100) = 1.375

The total price of 100 pens = 1.375 × 100 = Rs. 137.50

He sold remaining pens at the cost price.

The remaining pens = 600 - (480 + 100) = 600 - 580 = 20

The selling price of 20 pens = 20 × 1 = Rs. 20

Total selling price = 600 + 137.50 + 20 = Rs. 757.50

Profit percentage = [(757.50 - 600)/600] × 100 = 157.50/6 = 26.25%

**∴ The profit percentage of the shopkeeper in the transaction is 26.25%**

questions.question: A bus covers a certain distance in 1 hour 30 minutes at a speed of 11(1)/(9) m/sec. A car covers the same distance in 36 minutes. What is the ratio of the speeds of the bus and car?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The bus covers a distance in 1 hour 30 minutes at a speed of 11(1)/(9) m/sec

The car covers the same distance in 36 minutes

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

The speed of the bus = 11(1)/(9) m/sec = 100/9 m/s = 600/9 meter/minutes [∵ 1 minute = 60 seconds]

Time is taken by bus = 1 hour 30 minutes = (60 + 30) minutes = 90 minutes

The distance = (600/9) × 90 meters

The speed of the car = [(600/9) × 90]/36 meter/minutes = 6000/36 meter/minutes

Bus's speed : Car's speed = (600/9) : (6000/36)

= 2400 : 6000

= 2 : 5

**∴ The ratio of the speeds of the bus and car is 2 : 5**

questions.question: A Person travelled a distance of 150 km and then returned to the starting point. The time taken for the outward journey was 2(1)/(2) hours more than that for the return journey. His speed for the return journey was 10 km/h more than that for the outward journey. His speed for the return journey, in km/h, was:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total distance = 150 km

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation:**

Let, the speed of outward journey = x km/h

So, the speed of return journey = (x + 10) km/h

Then, 150/x - 150/(x + 10) = 2(1)/(2)

⇒ (150(x+10)-150x)/(x(x+10))=(5)/(2)

⇒ (150x+1500-150x)/(x(x+10))=(5)/(2)

⇒ (1500)/(x²+10x)=(5)/(2)

⇒ (300)/(x²+10x)=(1)/(2)

⇒ x² + 10x = 600

⇒ x2 + 10x - 600 = 0

⇒ x2 + 30x - 20x - 600 = 0

⇒ x (x + 30) - 20 (x + 30) = 0

⇒ (x - 20) (x + 30) = 0

⇒ x - 20 = 0 ⇒ x = 20

⇒ x + 30 = 0 ⇒ x = - 30 ("-" will be naglated)

∴ The speed of the return journey = (20 + 10) km/h = 30 km/h

**∴ The person's speed for the return journey, in km/h, was 30 km/h**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is 35% above its cost price. After giving a 20% discount on the marked price, it is sold for Rs. 432. What is the cost price of the article?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, the cost price = 100 units

∴ Market price = 100 + 100 of 35% = 135 units

The selling price = 135 - 135 of 20% = 108 units

So, 108 units = Rs. 432

⇒ 100 units = (432/108) × 100 = Rs. 400

∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 400

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The marked price of an article is 35% above its cost price

The selling price = Rs. 432

**Formula used:**

S.P. = (100 - Discount%)/100 × M.P.

**Calculation:**

Let, the cost price of the article = x

Then, the market price = 135x/100

So, (135x/100) × [(100 - 20)/100] = 432

⇒ (135x/100) × (80/100) = 432

⇒ x = 432 × (100/135) × (100/80)

⇒ x = 400

**∴ The cost price of the article is Rs. 400**
